footnote_text: Pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement"), dated as of July 20, 2026, by and among the Issuer, Idaho USA, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Acquiror"), Idaho Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and direct or indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Acquiror ("Merger Sub"), and Intersnack Group GmbH & Co. KG, a German limited partnership (Kommanditgesellschaft) ("Parent"), on November 20, 2026, Merger Sub merged with and into the Issuer (the "Merger"), with the Issuer surviving and becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. As a result of the Merger, the Class A Common Stock was delisted from the New York Stock Exchange and will be deregistered under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. || At the effective time of the Merger (the "Effective Time"), and pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, each share of Class A Common Stock held by the Reporting Person was automatically converted into the right to receive $14.25 per share (the "Merger Consideration"), in cash, without interest.

KG, a German limited partnership (Kommanditgesellschaft) ("Parent"), on November 20, 2026, Merger Sub merged with and into the Issuer (the "Merger"), with the Issuer surviving and becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. As a result of the Merger, the Class A Common Stock was delisted from the New York Stock Exchange and will be deregistered under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. || At the Effective Time, and pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, each share of Class A Common Stock held by the Reporting Person was automatically converted into the right to receive $14.25 per share (the "Merger Consideration"), in cash, without interest and net of applicable withholding taxes.

Pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement"), dated as of July 20, 2026, by and among the Issuer, Idaho USA, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Acquiror"), Idaho Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and direct or indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Acquiror ("Merger Sub"), and Intersnack Group GmbH & Co. KG, a German limited partnership (Kommanditgesellschaft) ("Parent"), on November 20, 2026, Merger Sub merged with and into the Issuer (the "Merger"), with the Issuer surviving and becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent. As a result of the Merger, the Class A Common Stock was delisted from the New York Stock Exchange and will be deregistered under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. || At the Effective Time, and pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, each restricted stock unit ("RSU") and PSU held by the Reporting Person was converted into the contingent right to receive an amount, in cash, without interest, equal to the sum of (x) the product of (A) the number of shares of Class A Common Stock subject to such award and (B) the Merger Consideration and (y) all cash dividend equivalents accrued or credited with respect to such award (each, a "Restricted Cash Award"). Each Restricted Cash Award continues to have, and remains subject to, the same terms and conditions (excluding any performance conditions and additional dividend equivalent rights), including vesting terms and conditions, as applied to the corresponding award immediately prior to the Effective Time and will be payable in cash within thirty days following the vesting thereof.
